desc: The Erqi Yangtze River Bridge is a highway bridge over the Yangtze River in Wuhan, Hubei Province, China. The bridge is 2,922 metres long and carries eight lanes of traffic of the Second Ring Road. With two main spans of 616 metres it is the world's longest double span cable-stayed bridge.
fact: Construction of the bridge began in 2008 and the bridge was opened on December 31, 2011 · The bridge is 2,922 metres long and carries eight lanes of traffic of the Second Ring Road

desc: The Zhongzhou Yangtze River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge over the Yangtze River in Zhong County of Chongqing, China. Completed in 2009, the bridge carries traffic on the G50 Shanghai–Chongqing Expressway.
